subtitle: Collect, Build, Discover Fish
keywords: coral reef,tide pool,fish tank,aquarium,collect fish,ocean pets,casual sim
promotional_text: Build your dream reef in Coral Tide. Collect 52 fish, feed and grow them, decorate your tanks, and explore four ocean habitats.
description: Coral Tide is a beautiful aquarium simulation where you catch fish, build your tanks, and create a living underwater world. Features: 52 unique fish species across 4 habitats, animated swimming, strategic feeding for growth, decorations for your aquarium, exploration in Coral Reef, Deep Ocean, Ice Sea, and Hidden Cave, a collection album, tank upgrades, and a coin economy. Explore each zone, catch rare fish, feed them as they grow, and build the most beautiful reef.
app_review_notes: Coral Tide is an offline aquarium simulation. Players explore zones to catch fish, then manage their aquarium by feeding fish and decorating tanks. No sign-in is required. Fish are shown as emoji, and food items use decorative card graphics.
